tasks.title: Preserve selected Session across Agents, Workspaces, and Board
tasks.objective: Keep one selected Session as the navigation context when the user changes the main surface.
tasks.outcome: Agents selection, Workspaces projection, and Board execution row stay aligned to the same Session.
acceptance: Selecting or opening a Session records the selected Session identity without changing its Runtime or creating duplicate Regions.

Switching to Workspaces reveals the selected Session's existing workbench location; switching to Agents preserves its selected detail; switching to Board marks and reveals the corresponding execution row when present.
Unknown or retired Session identities do not clear the current surface and continue using the existing recoverable notice path.
Removing the cross-surface navigation contract makes the focused tests red, and production callers remain present.

verification.ref: pnpm --filter @agentmux/desktop exec vitest run test/session-context-navigation.test.ts test/global-agents-surface.test.ts --maxWorkers=1
verification.proves: Session selection and cross-surface navigation behavior.
Store and surface changes compile cleanly.
The navigation context remains connected to the product store.

tasks.title: Give Agent Input text the available composer width
tasks.objective: Make the one-line Agent Input editor use the available middle space instead of being squeezed by controls.
tasks.outcome: Long input wraps across the composer width while tool and session controls retain stable hit targets.
acceptance: Collapsed composer layout uses a flexible editor track with bounded control tracks; no fixed narrow middle column is introduced.
Long drafts wrap in the editor and the existing rail identity, send, mailbox, and view controls remain accessible.
Removing the flexible-width contract makes the focused style test red.

verification.proves: Agent Input markup and style contract.
The reusable editor remains connected to Agent Input.
